parent_objective: Build a material-calibrated coherence-domain model: same Ni/H functional, coupled ionic/electronic response, physical loss/energy flow, actual many-region dynamics and matched lattice comparison, with explicit nuclear bridge. No reward for manufactured rejection.
positive_intent: Construct the actual ordinary-NC Ni/H static action bridge independently from scalar SCF free energies and forces, at Gamma and a commensurate nonzero q. This brings the new finite-functional construction into the real pipeline without re-running G10 qualification or launching a full material matrix.
source_scope: Existing nonstationary two-atom engineering cell, SG15Ni18/H1, collinear spin-PBE FD0.002Ry,60/240Ry,k222/20bands per spin, fixed mean neutralN with magnetization relaxed. This is not stationary Ni31H6 or full G1/G2.

coordinates.half_b1: 2x1x1 supercell, identical ordered (Ni,H) in translations0,a1; amplitudes alternate+/-; selfconjugate q=(1/2,0,0), no doublecount
coordinates.supercell_sampling: k122,40bands/spin; originalFD width/cutoffs/conv_thr retained; energy and conjugate force normalized per2 primitive cells

equations.force: Hab=-[Qa(+h eb)-Qa(-h eb)]/(2h), Qa=sum_R sign(R) F_atom,a(R)/Ncells. Retain raw H12 and H21, no symmetry repair.
equations.functional: Use full native XML output/total_energy/etot (Hartree converted toRy), full entropy-smearing freeenergy, not internal energy or summed eigenvalues. Full local/nonlocal explicit and induced terms plus ion-ion included by native variational functional.
equations.comparison: Use existing unmassweighted, raw-ASR-disabled serialized Cartesian DFPT matrix. Consume existing parser rather than new XML matrix ordering.

numerical_design.cases: two new same-size baselines plus six signed directional SCFs per q per step =26 new SCFs; exact completed case cache reused if interrupted, no old proof replay
numerical_design.comparison_allowance_ry_per_bohr2: max(1e-4,0.01*max_abs(reference_2x2)) per matrix; report raw matrices/errors and step changes, no post-result loosening
numerical_design.baseline_matching: Before displacement wave, new primitive seeded baseline agrees with storedDFPTbackground and doubled-cellF0/2 agrees with new primitiveF0 within1e-7Ry; total magnetization perprimitive agrees within1e-3Bohr. If mismatch, repair branch/folding rather than label model impossible.
numerical_design.mutations: Wrong supercell normalization and omitted mixed curvature must differ from independently computed native target or be reported insensitive; these are translation/error checks, not physical no-go machinery.
numerical_design.analytic_closure: Centered directional stencils cancel nonzero first gradients; q pattern percell normalization follows periodic Hessian sum. Remaining quantities are actual native freeenergy/force derivatives on the fixed model.
numerical_design.prior_exposure: Read native PHI source examples and old primitive baseline; no blind prediction credit. G10 already admitted only its engineering scope.
